aka: 上海幂方资产管理有限公司
幂方资本管理（北京）有限公司

strategy.thesis: Pure-play medical/biomedical investor covering VC, PE, PIPE and industrial M&A funds exclusively in pharma health and life sciences; has invested in ~60 China biopharma/medtech companies including 天广实 (Immunotech/biologics), 亦诺微 (oncolytic virus), 心擎医疗 (medtech) and 澎立生物 (preclinical CRO).

summary.en: Shanghai-based fund manager founded 2014 that invests exclusively across VC/PE/PIPE/M&A vehicles in pharma, healthcare and life sciences, with roughly ¥1B under management and ~60 China biopharma/medtech portfolio companies.
summary.local: 幂方资本成立于2014年，总部位于上海，专注于医药健康与生命科学领域的VC/PE/PIPE及产业并购基金投资，管理资金规模近10亿元，已投资约60家医药健康企业。

sources.title: 幂方健康基金-动脉网
sources.supports: founded_year 2014, AUM, sector focus, portfolio companies
sources.quote: 幂方资本成立于2014年，专注于医药健康与生命科学领域投资。幂方健康基金的总部位于上海...管理资金规模近10亿元，目前已经完成了十几家企业的投资与并购。基金已完成包括捍宇医疗、天广实、亦诺微、赞荣医药、凌科药业、澎立生物、心擎医疗等约六十家医药企业投资。

verification_notes: Listed as a known anchor for this micro-emerging slice; note founded_year 2014 predates the ~2018 typical cutoff for this segment and AUM (~¥1B, roughly $140M) is somewhat above the <$100M guideline, but the firm manages several smaller sub-funds and is retained per orchestrator instruction. AUM figure is a secondary-source approximation ('近10亿元'), not an official fund-by-fund disclosure.

aka: 杭州比邻星创新投资管理合伙企业（有限合伙）

strategy.thesis: Focuses on disruptive biotechnology, innovative therapeutics, novel medical devices, breakthrough diagnostics, clinically meaningful digital-health solutions and healthcare-data platforms, plus new business models emerging from China's healthcare-system reform; manages both RMB and USD funds from angel to growth stage.

people.name: 孙晓路 (Xiaolu Sun)
people.background: Former Philips senior scientist/manager; former partner (RMB & USD funds) at DT Capital Partners (德同资本)

people.name: 李喆 (Zhe Li)
people.background: Founder of international biomedical incubator 百创汇 (Bai Chuang Hui)

summary.en: Hangzhou-based healthcare-focused venture firm founded in late 2016 by two Zhejiang University classmates; invests from angel to growth stage in biotech, medtech, diagnostics and digital health, having backed 65 companies including 16 biopharma firms and helped launch 29 of them.
summary.local: 比邻星创投成立于2016年底，总部位于杭州，专注投资医疗行业中具有重要创新的快速成长企业，覆盖天使到成长期，累计投资65家企业，其中生物制药领域布局16家。

sources.title: 探究医疗创新投资新秀比邻星创投：聚焦重大临床需求，在全球医疗科技变革中把握投资机会-动脉网
sources.supports: founded_year 2016, portfolio_count 65, founders' backgrounds, sector focus
sources.quote: 比邻星创投成立于2016年底，自成立以来在全球共投资了65家企业，支持了50多个全球首创产品，其中协助发起设立了29家...并已在生物制药布局投资16家企业。两位创始人孙晓路和李喆是浙大同班同学。孙晓路曾在飞利浦任资深科学家和高级经理，在德同资本担任人民币和美元基金的合伙人；李喆则一手创立了国际生物医药孵化器百创汇。

verification_notes: Listed as a known anchor for this slice. Founded late 2016, slightly before the ~2018 typical cutoff but treated as an emerging/micro manager per orchestrator instruction given its scale and vintage. Fund size (raw $ or RMB figure) not found in sources reviewed; omitted rather than guessed.

aka: 深圳市奇迹之光创业投资企业（有限合伙）

strategy.thesis: Shenzhen-based angel/early-stage fund investing across healthcare/medical and traditional-manufacturing sectors; healthcare deals include pharmaceutical development, diagnostic solutions and medical-equipment companies.

summary.en: Shenzhen angel/early-stage investment fund founded 2016 that splits its book between healthcare (pharma R&D, diagnostics, medical equipment) and traditional manufacturing.
summary.local: 奇迹之光基金（深圳市奇迹之光创业投资企业）成立于2016年，专注天使及早期投资，涵盖医疗健康与传统制造领域，已投资包括医药研发、诊断和医疗设备企业在内的多个项目。

strategy.thesis: Hubei-based generalist early/mid-stage investor spanning healthcare, enterprise services, consumer/life services and advanced manufacturing; active biopharma dealmaking includes co-leading (with Hankang Capital) a >¥200M angel round for oncology-drug developer 上海思璞锐医药 in 2024.

summary.en: Hubei-headquartered generalist VC founded in 2017 with healthcare as one of its core verticals alongside enterprise services and advanced manufacturing; recently co-led a large angel round into an oncology-focused biotech.
summary.local: 博远资本成立于2017年，总部位于湖北，投资领域涉及医疗、企业服务、生活服务、先进制造等，2024年联合汉康资本领投肿瘤新药研发公司思璞锐医药超2亿元人民币天使轮。

aka: 浙江华方资产管理有限公司

strategy.thesis: Early-to-mid-stage market-based fund manager under Huali Group (华立集团); roughly 80% of its investments are in biopharma, leveraging the group's listed-company resources in biomedicine and advanced manufacturing to support portfolio companies, with a focus on innovative technology platforms and drug-device combination projects.

summary.en: Zhejiang-based early/mid-stage fund manager under Huali Group, founded 2017, with roughly 80% of its portfolio in biopharma including drug-device combination and innovative technology-platform projects.
summary.local: 华方资本（浙江华方资产管理有限公司）成立于2017年，是华立集团旗下专注中早期投资的市场化基金管理人，生物医药领域投资占比达到80%，关注创新技术平台和药械结合类项目。

sources.title: 华方资本路驰：生物医药投资占比达八成，关注创新技术平台和药械结合类项目
sources.quote: 华方资本成立于2017年，是华立集团旗下专注中早期投资的市场化基金管理人...目前华方在生物医药领域的投资规模占比达到80%
